pulledFrom.note: GET /api/settings is not a JSON route; it falls through to the web app. Current values come from /api/state prefs and rules, which are the KV store snapshot the desk also writes on POST /api/settings. 13.30 live values were not re-pulled: the desk token is not available to the branch author. The 13.29 values below stand until the release deploy re-pulls them.

backend.tls: Caddy on :443, Let's Encrypt ACME (HTTP-01 disabled). No :80 listener; HTTP redirects are disabled.

auth.tokenFormat: Opaque shared secret from the DESK_TOKEN env var. Any non-empty trimmed UTF-8 string. Not a JWT and not an Authorization Bearer token. Compared with SHA-256 plus timing-safe equality. The value is never logged and must never be committed.
auth.whenUnset: If DESK_TOKEN is empty or whitespace, the gate stays open (local-open). Production has a token set.

clients.android: Paste the token on the Link screen (stored as preference desk_token). Every HTTP call sends header X-Desk-Token and also appends ?token= (URL-encoded). The WebSocket opens wss://<host>/ws?token= and also sets the header.
clients.web: A first visit may carry ?token=. The page copies it into sessionStorage key night-desk-token, then strips it from the address bar. Later fetches send header X-Desk-Token and also set the query param. Authorization: Bearer is not accepted.
clients.serverCookie: On every authorized response the desk also sets HttpOnly cookie desk_token; Path=/; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=2592000, so a browser session can keep working after the query string is removed.

hardRules: AI auto-buys stay paper-only. liveAutoBuy cannot be turned on; POST /api/settings with liveAutoBuy=true is refused. liveScope is manual: operator buys, limits and stops may send real swaps; AI never spends live.
Never drop the v13.11 baseline controls: paper and live limit / take-profit / stop orders (GET/POST /api/orders, POST /api/orders/cancel), and the rest of the v13.11 book and ticket UI.

Bogus-price rejection stays on (src/market/mark-guard.ts). Unusable marks (non-finite or ≤0) are rejected. Implausible upward jumps and unit/decimal or SOL-vs-USD mix-ups (including a rise of 25× or more) do not update equity or stops unless confirmed. A genuine crash or rug is never rejected by this guard, so the stop can still fire.
The hard stop cannot be loosened past 6%. LIVE_TRADING, the wallet secret, and mode cannot be changed from the API.
Do not print secrets. RPC URLs may carry API keys in the path or query; publish hostnames only.
Every Night Desk release PR must update docs/DESK_SETTINGS.md and docs/desk-settings.json in the same PR so these files stay current.

13.30: the trading engine trades the paper book only. Its buys go through the analyst path, which refuses the live book. The engine stop can only sit tighter than the hard stop and never moves it. The scorecard ready flag arms nothing.

settings._storage: SQLite KV key 'settings' at DB_PATH (/var/lib/night-desk/desk.sqlite). POST /api/settings writes the allowed patch. Saved rows win over env boot defaults. Read them back from /api/state as prefs (most keys) or rules (volume, analyst line, top-10, position %, stop, trail arm/gap, entry slippage, volume boost, revengeCooldownMs).

minHolderCount.notes: 8:22 PM ET tuning. While enrich is on Alchemy (not Helius) the UI caps this at 20: a full top-20 list counts as 20 or more.

maxDevHoldingPct.notes: Set after the 13.29 deploy via POST /api/settings {"maxDevHoldingPct": 10} only. 0 = off. Stored as a fraction (10 → 0.1).

allowUnlockedLp.notes: Mint authority and dev rugs stay hard kills.

analystMinScore.notes: Trade line. Band 0.10–0.95. Scores below this reject with SCORE_BELOW_THRESHOLD.

volumeBoost.notes: Adds to the analyst score for high 1h volume; never lowers a score or lifts past 1.

autoBuy.notes: AI / auto-buy on the paper book only.

liveAutoBuy.notes: Server forces this false. Cannot be enabled.

liveTradeUsd.notes: Per live trade. Band $1–$100. Do not change unless Dirk approves.

liveDailyCapUsd.notes: Daily live spend cap. Do not change unless Dirk approves.

stopLossPct.notes: Hard stop. Locked at 6% or tighter; the desk refuses a looser stop. Current value is tighter than the 6% ceiling.

trailArmPct.notes: Profit the trail waits for before it locks in gains. Floor 12%.

maxExitSlippage.notes: Leave at 6% unless Dirk approves a change.

cooldownHours.notes: A hard stop does not ban the mint. revengeCooldownMs is also 0.

operatorReady.notes: Operator checklist only. It does not set LIVE_TRADING or place a trade.

tradingEngine._note: 13.30. Stored in SQLite KV key strategy (not in prefs/rules). Default when nothing is saved: enabled = FEED_MODE=live and DEMO_FEED=0, so on for the Oracle host. Values below are the code defaults; re-pull after deploy.

enabled.notes: Off: analyst passes are bought on sight as in 13.29. On: they are watched for a Launch or Momentum signal first.

tradeUsd.notes: Up to the 50% auto ceiling; the exposure cap still applies.

maxOpen.notes: Engine positions only. maxOpenPositions still caps the whole book.

active.notes: The hard stop (2.5% on this host) is checked first, so a 3% or 6% active variant can never reach its own stop on the main book. Shadow books use their own stop.

dailyPauseUsd.notes: New engine buys pause once the paper book is $10 down on the UTC day.

shadowBooks.notes: Closed trades in SQLite table shadow_trades. Open shadow positions are dropped on restart. Ready = 200 trades with net profit; information only.

runtime.detail: Cloudflare challenge on frontend-api-v3.pump.fun. HTTP coin discovery is off. The free Pump stream is separate.

scoutBitquery.notes: The toggle is on, but the source stays off until BITQUERY_API_KEY is set. That key is not present in the production env file.

enrich.secret: secret, not in repo (URL may carry an API key in the path or query; hostname only)

walletMarksSwaps.role: Wallet balances, held-position marks, and live swaps
walletMarksSwaps.secret: secret, not in repo (URL has a query string; hostname only)

walletWs.role: Optional RPC websocket, derived or set separately
walletWs.secret: secret, not in repo (URL has a query string; hostname only)

heliusLaneCaps.notes: Hard sliding-minute ceilings in src/market/net.ts. The two reqLastMin counts must never pass 18. Leave these caps unchanged unless Dirk approves.

enrichLane.notes: Used because SOLANA_RPC_URL is Alchemy, not Helius. HOLDER_PAGES_MAX is ignored on a non-Helius enrich host (top 20 only).

env.note: Names only. Secret values and any URL with an API key are omitted. Production env is not changed by a docs PR.

variables.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.notes: Desk-host only. Never in the phone, chat, or git.

variables.name: WALLET_KEYPAIR_PATH
variables.notes: Optional path alternative to WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY. Not set in the production env file.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.notes: Commentary only. Never used to place or size a trade.

variables.name: LIVE_TRADING
variables.notes: Only the exact string true arms live (with a valid key). The phone cannot set this.

variables.name: PAPER_BALANCE_USD
variables.notes: Used only for a fresh book or PAPER_RESET=1. The live paper book is already larger.

variables.name: PUMP_WS_URL
variables.notes: Do not commit a URL that has an api-key query string.

variables.name: STRATEGY_ENGINE
variables.notes: 13.30 optional. 1/0 sets the engine default when no switch is saved. Not in the production env file: the default is on because FEED_MODE=live and DEMO_FEED=0.

walletPublic.notes: Public address only. The private key never belongs in this repo.

api.note: All of these require the desk token when DESK_TOKEN is set. GET /api/settings is not implemented; it serves the SPA HTML.

endpoints.notes: publicUrl is a trycloudflare tunnel URL when data/public-url.txt has one; production Caddy host reports null.

Full desk snapshot. This is how clients read settings (prefs + rules). Paper cash/equity are cashUsd / equityUsd. Live book is liveBook. 13.30: strategy is the trading engine scorecard (settings, watching, six shadow-book rows, stats, note); perf is timing per pipeline step (sightingToCandidate, candidateToDecision, watchToSignal, signalToFill).

endpoints.body: Partial object of allowed keys only. Send percents the way the clients already do (e.g. maxDevHoldingPct: 10 for 10%). Only changed fields should be sent.
endpoints.notes: liveAutoBuy=true is refused. Blocked keys include stopLoss, liveTrading, LIVE_TRADING, mode, and any wallet secret field. stopLossPct may be tightened but not loosened past 6%.
On an armed desk the client must name the book (paper or live). Omitted is refused, not live. Size omitted uses the position cap, cut to liveTradeUsd on the live book.
Sell size must be 25, 50 or 100 percent (or a fraction in (0,1]]. Omitted = 100%.
v13.11 limit / take-profit / stop orders, paper and live.

endpoints.body: Order ticket fields plus optional idemKey

endpoints.notes: Cannot set LIVE_TRADING, a keypair, or a seed.
Paper book only. Live mode is refused. startingUsd 100–10,000.
Pump terminal, journal, portfolio, sniper, alerts, and related screens. Same auth gate.
Same auth (header, ?token=, or cookie). Pushes coalesced snapshots and mark deltas.

13.30 trading engine: settings, watch count, per-variant results (trades, wins, winRate, avgWinUsd, avgLossUsd, netUsd, avgNetUsd, maxDrawdownUsd, equityUsd, open, active, ready), stats, note. Paper only.
13.30. Body keys: enabled (bool), targetNetUsd (0.25-50), tradeUsd (5-500), maxOpen (1-6), active ({launch, momentum} variant ids). Cannot arm live trading. Saved in SQLite KV key strategy.
13.30. Requires {"confirm": true}. Wipes the six shadow books and the shadow_trades table. The main paper book is untouched.

standingPipeline: Wait for hosted CI to finish green on the exact PR head. If CI fails, report it; do not silently fix it.
Review the diff against the hard rules (AI paper-only, live $5/$20, stops/trail/6% exit slippage, cooldown 0, bogus-price rejection, Helius caps, no secret leakage).
Squash-merge, then confirm the merge tree matches the tested head tree.

Build the APK and re-sign it with the existing Android debug certificate sha256 2c69c1b3d33c812142bf0d214e890e084227f01c84f234a8246f2acc7d111f04. Publish a GitHub release vX.Y with NightDesk-vX.Y-debug.apk and a private Drive copy.
Back up Oracle, deploy the merged tree to /opt/night-desk-releases/<merge sha>, leave /etc/night-desk/night-desk.env unchanged, and restart only the night-desk service.
Watch the desk and report version, pipeline, paper cash/equity, live book (0 unexpected spends), and provider error counts.
releaseFlow.docsInSamePr: Every Night Desk release must update docs/DESK_SETTINGS.md and docs/desk-settings.json in the same PR, pulling the then-current Oracle values and any newly added settings, endpoints, or env names.

filterSemantics1329.holders: When enrich only sees the top 20 accounts (Alchemy today; HOLDER_PAGES_MAX=0), a full list of 20 counts as 20 or more.
filterSemantics1329.devShare: Computed from the top-20 holders. Pool vaults are excluded. Any share over 100% fails closed.
filterSemantics1329.recheck: Coins that miss only the soft filters get one recheck. Counts are on /api/state.recheck (pending, ran, dropped).
